author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 0; ensure at least four current turns classified as general across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a blender's jar material, then pivots to a refund for a different order.

messages.content: Hi, is the jar on the VitaBlend 500 made of glass or plastic?
It's a BPA-free Tritan plastic jar, very durable.
Okay, thanks. Actually, I also need a refund for the toaster I got last week.
Sure, I can help with that. What's the issue with the toaster?

variants.text: It stopped heating after two days, and I'd like my money back.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Never mind the toaster, does the blender come with a tamper?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: It stopped heating, and also can you tell me if the blender jar is dishwasher safe?
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer greets and asks about store hours, then asks for a human agent.

messages.content: Good morning! What are your customer service hours?
We're available 8am to 10pm every day.
Great, thanks for letting me know.
You're welcome! Anything else I can help with?

variants.text: Actually, can I speak to a real person? This bot isn't helping.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: No, that's all. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: One more thing, my login keeps failing. Can you fix that?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer tracks a package, then shifts to asking about a coupon code.

messages.content: Where is my order #8821? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
It's out for delivery today and should arrive by 6pm.
Perfect, thank you.
Happy to help! Is there anything else?

variants.text: Yes, do you have any promo codes right now?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I want to cancel that order before it arrives.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait, can you change the delivery address? I won't be home.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer reports a login problem, then withdraws and asks a product question.

messages.content: I can't log into my account, it says my password is wrong.
I can send a reset link to your email. Would you like that?
Hold on, let me try one more time.
No problem, take your time.

variants.text: It worked! I'm in now. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Still locked out. Please send the reset link.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: While I'm at it, does the smartwatch support iOS?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a laptop's specs, then requests a return label.

messages.content: Does the NovaBook 14 have a backlit keyboard?
Yes, it has a full backlit keyboard with three brightness levels.
Nice. I actually bought one and want to return it.
I can help with that. May I ask why you're returning it?

variants.text: The screen has a dead pixel, and I want a replacement.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, keep it. Can you tell me the battery life instead?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: The screen is faulty, and I also need help resetting my password.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer asks about shipping to a remote area, then greets casually.

messages.content: Do you ship to rural Alaska?
Yes, but delivery takes 7-10 business days there.
Okay, that works for me.
Great! Let me know if you need anything else.

variants.text: Thanks so much, you've been really helpful!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, can you ship it faster with express?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: One more thing, how do I apply a gift card at checkout?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer complains about a late order and asks to escalate.

messages.content: My order has been stuck in transit for two weeks. This is unacceptable.
I'm sorry for the delay. Let me check the tracking for you.
I've already checked. I want to file a formal complaint.
I understand your frustration. I can escalate this to a supervisor.

variants.text: Yes, please escalate it now.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, just refund me instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Forget the complaint, just tell me when it will arrive.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a vacuum's filter, then asks about warranty coverage.

messages.content: How often should I replace the filter on the DustPro X?
Every 3-6 months depending on use.
Got it. Is the filter covered under warranty?
Filters are consumables, so they're not covered by the standard warranty.

variants.text: That's disappointing. Can I buy a multi-pack of filters?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Okay, thanks for clarifying. That's all I needed.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Then I want to return the vacuum entirely.
variants.label: billing_refund
